bounded_checks.findings: Corrected the final library's distal end: it is now sliced from the published oligos (Adapter 2 N7 Forward plus the reverse complement of Index Reverse) instead of the canonical INDEX1_PRIMER constant. Index Reverse (CAAGCAGAAGACGGCATACGAGAT-TA-N8-GACTGGAGTTCAGACGTGTGCTC, identical in both supplements) primes on its 3' 19 bases, so the top strand reads ...GAACTCCAGTC-[i7]-TA-P7' and the i7 index sits two bases closer to the Read 2 arm than in a stock TruSeq library; the stock TruSeq Index 1 primer therefore has no exact site, now declared via seqprimers.mismatching with that reason and shown as a page Highlight, a CAVEAT and a note section. Added the previously missing 15-base Adapter 2 constant arm (GTCGTATTAGTAGTA) to the library. Adapter 2 ligation geometry changed from blunt to a derived 3'-T cohesive end (the 15-nt Reverse strand pairs with the first 14 bases of each Forward strand, leaving its phosphorothioate T unpaired), scoped as derived and consistent with the named Blunt/TA Ligase and End Repair/dA-tailing module. Added the Proteinase K/RNase A termination step and the SPRI 2 cleanup with its residual-Adapter-1 waste branch (the protocol states this prevents adapter dimer). Named the actual reagents and conditions (Klenow, Quick Ligase, NEBNext dsDNA Fragmentase, Ultra End Repair/dA-tailing mix, Blunt/TA Ligase + enhancer, Dynabeads M-280, Q5 Hot Start, 12+12 cycles, on-bead recovery PCR). Gave the oligo/adapter inputs their published sequences so the source guard can check them.
